Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000306" [constraint]: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000281" [decision]: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000263" [decision]: The Ember team owns the billing API as of 2025-03-07, when ownership passed from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000250": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team, which took over ownership from the Boreal team on 2025-03-03.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000246": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, cache change)
- memory_id "1000226": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000224" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000218" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway, change policy)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000183" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000180" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000171": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000140": The Ember team owns the authentication gateway.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000136": The Ember team owns the job scheduler.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000105": Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000094": The Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000063": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
Existing entity names: Ember team, Oskar, image resizer, Atlas team, billing API, Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, ledger service, cache change, notifier, push provider, authentication gateway, change policy, the bus, job scheduler, INC-2025-004

[2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
